Market today: Tech is still the main driver, with NVDA hitting new highs. Your concentrated tech/chip book, especially on margin, means any dip hits hard.

Your holdings: SOXL (-25.41%) and SPAL (-26.32%) are flagged for attention. They are leveraged ETFs and decay is a constant risk, especially when they're down.

Watch: Keep an eye on SMH. It's currently flat but has a scanner setup that could signal a move.

Bottom line: Manage your risk on the leveraged names and watch for opportunities in the broader tech sector.
plays: SOXL: Consider trimming exposure if it continues to fall below your stop.
SPAL: Similar to SOXL, evaluate trimming if the downtrend persists.
No new buys today - hold and watch
